name: Jerzy Sandek
original_name: イェジー・サンダーク
source:
Idol’s commanding officer and the man in charge of the ПЗ plan, the Soviet Union’s strategy against the BETA. Has an iron will and cold personality, and is constantly scheming. He is the one who suggested proving tests in actual combat against the BETA on the Kamchatka Peninsula, and he is also in charge of arranging matters on the ground. Sandek himself is a surface pilot, and a good one.

[From [url=https://muvluv.com/en/total-eclipse]Official website[/url]]
